winner.title: 6 Impossible Questions You Can Solve on an Envelope
winner.why: The title promises six questions with one-calculation answers; the cover shows the channel's figure setting off toward the Moon, the plain 'you doing something ordinary at an impossible scale' idea, with no answer on screen.

checksNote: duplication: the thumbnail has no text. truth: it is the Episode 1 art, and the film shows that walk. competition and originality are my own judgments, not measured.
chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 (1920x1080).
Subject: a small clay-style blue figurine with a round head and no face, seen from behind and mid-stride, walking along a thin glowing magenta (#EB63FF) path that curves up toward a cratered grey clay Moon; the edge of a dark clay Earth with white outlined continents sits behind and below it.
Composition: low three-quarter camera behind the figure; the figure large on the left-centre, about 70% of the frame height; the path sweeping to the Moon in the upper right; a lot of dark space; nothing important in the extreme corners.
Lighting and treatment: a warm desk lamp glowing in the top-left corner on a dark graph-paper tabletop, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, tactile clay texture, deep warm-black background.
Mood: wonder and anticipation: a small person facing an impossible distance.
Text: No text.
Scientific accuracy: the Moon is much smaller and farther than the Earth would suggest; the picture shows the setup only and no answer; it is a stylised illustration, not a photograph.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces, realistic people, logos, watermarks, extra text, rockets or anything that looks like a NASA photo.
Style: premium, art-directed, handmade clay-stop-motion look; not photorealistic, not generic AI art.
